code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    if hr:
        d=hr[0]
        for r in range(d):
            for c in range(w):
                if g[r][c]!=bg:
                    color=g[r][c]
                    g[r][c]=bg
                    g[d-1 if color==g[d+1][c] else 0][c]=color
    else:
        d=vc[0]
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(d):
                if g[r][c]!=bg:
                    color=g[r][c]
                    g[r][c]=bg
                    g[r][d-1 if color==g[r][d+1] else 0]=color
    return g
'''
